items.q: Cecil Bridgewater. That’s right. I did some things for the group.

ctx.x: Cecil Bridgewater. That’s right. I did some things for the group. I remember one of the tunes I did – I don’t remember other things – only one I remember was I Remember Clifford, I think. Then he did his group with the string quartet.
